title: Express Covenant — tiered rapid-approval flow for small-concession MSA/DPA
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and run an experiment that enables Sales to obtain legally valid, signed MSAs/DPAs faster for low-risk deals by applying a deterministic, auditable rapid-approval flow. The flow (Express Covenant) combines automated clause fingerprinting, a quantitative concession score, and a pricing 'soundcheck' to auto-approve or fast-route small concessions while preserving legal and indemnity guardrails. Goal: reduce time-to-sign for low-risk contracts and lower Legal review load without increasing downstream indemnity or revenue leakage.
acceptance_criteria: A1: System can compute a Concession Risk Score from a completed concession form and clause fingerprint in under 3s for >95% requests.

A2: Auto-approve rules (tier thresholds) documented and implemented: auto-approve for deals with ARR <= $25k, max indemnity exposure delta <= $200k equivalent, and clause deviations limited to approved pool; otherwise, route to Legal with priority tag.
A3: Pricing Soundcheck integration returns an estimated revenue impact and passes for >=90% auto-approved cases, with clear override fields for Sales/Product Pricing team.
A4: Audit trail (who/when/which-rule) recorded in ContractOps and surfaced in Console for each rapid-approval decision.
